title: Death of Antiochus IV at Tabae in Persia (164 BC)
summary: After failing to plunder a temple in Elymaïs, Antiochus IV fell ill and died at Tabae in Persia; news of his death reached Babylon in Kislimu of Seleucid year 148.
external_reason: Proposed by preterist interpreters as the end foretold in Dan 11:45; the circumstances in 11:40–45 are disputed.

mentions.notes: Proposed correlation only; the setting "between the sea and the glorious holy mountain" does not match Tabae.

scripture_extraction.reason: External historical event, researched because interpreters read Daniel 11 as foretelling it; no biblical narrative of it in the 66-book index.
